# Third-party source

`contracts/test_token/src/main.nr` is copied from the Aztec v6.0.0 standard token contract (its test module is omitted). It is used by the registry's TXE tests.

Source: https://github.com/aztec-labs-eng/aztec-node/tree/v6.0.0/noir-projects/noir-contracts/contracts/app/token_contract

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included in `Aztec-LICENSE`. The compiled SDK artifact also includes compiler-emitted Aztec dependency sources. Other npm dependencies retain their own package licenses. ANS-authored code is licensed under Apache-2.0; see `../LICENSE`.
